description: Source code for AndroidIncludingCompiler class implementing SourceGeneratingCompiler, handling Android project compilation tasks such as gathering source files, managing dependencies, and copying files during build process.

classes.name: AndroidIncludingCompiler
classes.description: Implements SourceGeneratingCompiler to handle Android-specific compilation tasks, dependency management, and file copying during build.

classes.name: MyItem
classes.description: Inner class representing a source file item with module association, path, and validity state.

methods.name: getPresentableFile
methods.description: Returns the VirtualFile for a generated file, searching dependencies' source roots.

methods.name: getGenerationItems
methods.description: Collects and returns source items to be generated, considering dependencies and platform revisions.

methods.name: collectCompilableFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects Java source files from a source root, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Copies source files to output directory and refreshes build state.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description string for the compiler.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates compiler configuration, always returns true.

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a validity state object based on file timestamp.
